Bear Witness to the Truth
Core Values
At All Hallows our vision is: “…to form happy, successful students who reach their full potential and leave the school with integrity and moral purpose.” Students are encouraged to develop their character through our Core Values, which are underpinned by the seven Christian virtues of faith, hope, charity (love), prudence, temperance, justice and fortitude. Celebrating more than just academic achievement our Core Values empower students to be successful and prepared for all aspects of their life.Our Core Values are:
Respect Students show respect to God, others, and the All Hallows Community. They strive to have pride in themselves and demonstrate the highest standards of behaviour and appearance, actively engaging in the Catholic life of the school.CourageStudents demonstrate courage through determination and positive attitudes, never giving up and taking on new opportunities available to them throughout the school. Students have confidence in themselves and demonstrate integrity by standing up for others and what they believe in.ResponsibilityStudents take ownership of their actions and take responsibility for themselves to ensure they grow and develop as people as well as great learners.ConsiderationStudents are thoughtful and give their time for others, both within the All Hallows family and wider community. Students are friendly, caring and kind, working positively with peers and staff.Intellectual curiosityStudents use new ideas and concepts to challenge themselves and how they think. Logical and critical thinking stretches knowledge so that students think further both inside and outside of lessons. ​ Reward Structure:
